name: Tejassvi Aaharam Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Tejassvi Aaharam Ltd is a manufacturer of Pasta products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TAL is a Chennai-based manufacturer of Insta Pasta, Ying Yaang – Nest Vermicelli, Ying Yaang – Sooji Noodles, Veg Hakka Sooji Noodles, 
Seval Short Roasted Vermicelli, Milletz Ragi Vermicelli, Savoronii Macaroni, Gopuram Vermicelli, etc., under the brand name Tal
Chennai.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
